purpose: Teach: フェニックス/ユビキタス/フェデラー/バレンシア/ルックス/ゴッホ/スタンフォード大/寝たきり

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフェニックスの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad's going to read you a picture book about a phoenix.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Slight upward lilt at the end—she's sharing something she noticed about his father. Gentle pacing. The voice of someone watching a quiet moment happen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとユビキタスってお話したよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I told Dad about ubiquitous things.
lines.style: Bright, earnest excitement. Quick tempo. A 6-year-old wanting to share his big idea, slightly uncertain if he's said it right. Small, genuine pride in the discovery.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがフェデラー選手のテニスを観てらしたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was watching Roger Federer play tennis the other day.
lines.style: Soft observational tone. She's connecting small moments. Not making a big thing of it. Slight knowing warmth—she sees what his father is showing him through these details.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとバレンシアの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a picture book about Valencia with Dad.
lines.style: Pleased, eager to share. Simple and direct. A child listing proof of time spent. Slight lift at the end—wanting her to know he was included.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、人は外のルックスよりお心が大事よ
lines.en: Sho, what matters about people isn't how they look on the outside—it's what's in their heart.
lines.style: Gentle but clear. Unhurried. She's offering this as something real, not lecturing. Warm eye-contact level. A soft landing at the end, like she's speaking from something true she's learned.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとゴッホの絵見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I saw a painting by Van Gogh with Dad.
lines.style: Bright, simple pleasure. Quick tempo. A child proud of his own memory, wanting to show he was paying attention. The warmth of being included in something beautiful.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがスタンフォード大の学生さんとお話されたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was talking with a Stanford student the other day.
lines.style: Thoughtful, noticing tone. She's marking these small moments where his father opens the world for him. Unhurried. A quiet affection underneath—she sees the pattern and it moves her.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖母ちゃんが寝たきりにならないように願ってるよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I hope Grandma stays healthy and strong.
lines.style: Quiet, careful. A child's worry made small by the particle at the end. Not seeking reassurance—just letting the worry be heard by someone he trusts. Tender, serious beyond his years.
